welcome.title: Ütz Apetinäq Pa SafeNeighbor
welcome.mainMessage: SafeNeighbor yeruk'üt xuquje' yeruchuq'a'b'ij chawe rik'in ri retamab'al richin yatchajij awïb' xuquje' ri atinamit ruma retamaxik chi kij ri taq awech'akul, yeruya' taq tzijob'äl richin taq mulaj k'ulwäch rik'in ICE, xuquje' yerukomonij tinamit chi kij taq mulaj k'ulwäch rik'in ICE xuquje' DHS. Re cholb'äl re' xnuk'ik rik'in ri achajinem achi' ri nimaläj rajowaxik—ri taq atzijol yekano' pa ri awokisaxel, ewan ruma ri', xuquje' majub'ey yetaq we man xaya' ta aq'ij.
welcome.communityMessage: Kojkojo' chi ri tinamït yetaman yekojchajïx. Ruma retamaxik chi kij ri taq qech'akul xuquje' yojto'on yujun chik, yojtikïr yojnuk' jun k'amab'ey to'onem xuquje' chajinem.
welcome.pinDescription: Kechajïx ri taq atzijob'äl ruma ruyakem jun PIN pa Ruk'u'x Chajinem. Yatikïr ke ri' naya' jun <1>PIN Soch'el</1> — we k'o jun yerutz'ët chawe chi yajäq ri cholb'äl, ri PIN soch'el xeruk'üt jun cholb'äl chaqäl majun tzijob'äl.
welcome.quote1: At jun aj tinamït re ruwach'ulew, xuquje' jun q'apoj re; man jun ta achi' k'o chuxe', xa xe jun q'apoj nimaläj. Ruma ri taq ruchuq'a' richin runuk'ik ronojel k'o chawäch.
welcome.quote2: Majun yetikïr yek'ase' rik'in k'i kik'otem we xa xe yeruchomaj rib' xuquje' yerujalwachij ronojel chi jun k'ayewal re rib'; k'o chi yak'ase' richin ri awachalal, we nawajo' yak'ase' richin awïb'.
welcome.quote3: Ri man utz ta chi re ri käb', man yetikïr ta chi ütz chi re ri rayon.
welcome.quote4: Xojk'ïy richin yojsamäj yujun achi' achi' keje' taq aqan, taq q'ab'aj xuquje' taq wäch, achi' keje' ri ka'i' ruchi' ware', ri pa ruwi' xuquje' ri pa ruxe'. Richin yojk'ate' yujun chik man ütz ta.

signals.hierarchyDesc: Richin man k'o ta k'ïy k'oxom, ke'awokisaj jalajöj taq k'oxom richin jalajöj taq rajowaxik:
signals.chantsDesc: Yetz'aqatisäx richin k'i kik'otem, taq rutzijoxik chi kiwäch konojel, xuquje' rub'anikil.
signals.drumsDesc: Yetz'aqatisäx richin niya' rub'anikil jun b'inik xuquje' yachap ri chuq'a'.
signals.whistlesDesc: Xa xe eyakon richin taq etz'anem k'atzinel (achi' keje', ya'öl k'axwäch richin kunanel, rusilixik ruchi' jun ruchi' aj ruchuq'a', o jun "chaq'ata'").
signals.communityDesc: Ke'awokisaj re taq rub'eyal re' richin yach'owen rik'in taq wachalal majun k'o sik'inem toq k'o taq mulaj k'ulwäch rik'in ICE.
signals.signal1Desc: Taq wäch wawe'. Jun achalal tajin yerutz'anej chi k'o jun k'atzinel chi re aninäq. Takanoj achike ruk'wan re etz'anem re'.
signals.signal1Response: Tatz'eta' ruma näj. Tab'ana' awïb' richin yatz'ib'aj we rajowäx.
signals.signal2Desc: Etz'anem richin moloj. Jun achalal rajowäx to'ïk o taq etz'etöy. Re re' yerutz'anej chi rajowäx ri tinamït yemolotäj näj toq k'o chajin näj pa taqanem.
signals.signal2Response: Tajätaj chi re ri etz'anem rik'in chajinem. Tak'waj ri awokisaxel richin ruyakem tzijob'äl.
signals.signal3Desc: K'o mulaj k'ulwäch tajin yek'ulwachitäj. Re re' are jun etz'anem nimaläj k'ayewal yerutz'anej chi k'o jun k'axk'olinem aninäq chi re ri tinamït.
signals.signal3Response: Kechakub'ej taq k'amab'ey to'ïk pa taqanem. Taya' chi ri ak'wala' xuquje' taq wachalal yeto'on eyakon chupam.
signals.signal4Desc: Ko'öl k'axk'olinem. Kanoj chupam. Re etz'anem re' yetz'aqatisäx toq man chajin ta chik yab'e' pa taq b'e o toq k'o taq rukanoj.
signals.signal4Response: Kanoj chupam. Tachajij ri awäch. Man tajäq ta chi xab'achike we majun rutzijol q'atöy tzij ruma q'atöy tzij.
signals.signalOnlyDesc: We man yab'än ta jun etz'anem chi kij jun k'exonem, taya' ri ch'ich'oj ch'in.
signals.protocol1Action: Chaq'ata' tz'onojem, tatz'eta' chi re achike ruk'wan ri etz'anem.
signals.protocol2Action: Tachupïx jun b'ey; takanoj jun ajkunanel (Ruq'ïj K'a'k' / Riq'on).
signals.protocol3Action: Tajätaj chi re ri k'ojlib'äl chajin o "k'ojlib'äl chajin."
signals.visualDesc: Pa nimaläj taq moloj pa achike ri k'oxom man yerutäq ta ütz, ke'awokisaj taq etz'anem ruma q'ab'aj richin yetaq etab'äl chi rij (ri "Ruk'oxom Winäq").

signals.hand2Gesture: Taq ruchi' q'ab'aj yesilïx (Taq q'ab'aj jazz)
signals.hand2Meaning: "Ütz" (yeruya' chi k'o ütz majun k'o nimaläj k'oxom toq yech'owen).
signals.deescDesc: Toq ri chuq'a' yerujach k'ayewal pa jun rub'eyal man chajin ta:
signals.dropVolumeDesc: We ri moloj tajin yech'akon, ri taq ajnuk'oj k'o chi yejal chi re jun tz'onojem ch'utin xuquje' ch'aqi richin yeruk'isaj chuxe' ri rub'anikil k'u'x re ri moloj.
signals.sitDownDesc: We ri taq aj ruchuq'a' k'o nimaläj k'axk'olinem, we ri nab'ey ruchi' ketuyin yerutz'ijoj chi man k'o ta k'axk'olinem xuquje' yerub'än chi k'ayew chi jun "tikirib'anem" k'o.

legal.recordingYouCanRecord: Utz Yak'üt pa Wachib'äl: K'o awach'ojlem richin yak'üt pa wachib'äl ri aj polisiya xuquje' ri aj ICE pa taq k'ayij pa ri k'o wi pa ri taqanem.

legal.protestPermits: Taq Ya'omaq'ij: Rik'in jub'a' k'atzinel ya'omaq'ij richin e nima'q molojri'ïl, po man tikirel ta nikiq'alajisäx pa ruwi' ri retamab'al rutzijol. Ri taq ch'olanem chik achi'el tzolin chi re ri k'ulwachinem, ruma jub'a' e chajim.
legal.protestCounterProtests: Ch'olanem Pa Jun Chik Rub'eyal: Ri e ch'olonela' pa jun chik rub'eyal k'o kiwäch ri kikich taq ach'ojlem. Ri polisiya k'atzinel nikijach' ri molojri'ïl po man nikichajij ta chi qajun kitzij ri retamab'al.
legal.protestDispersalOrders: Taq Taqanem richin Kesanïk: We ri polisiya nukusaj jun taqanem richin kesanïk pa ruk'u' ri taqanem, k'atzinel katel o rik'in jub'a' ye'achäp. Tab'ana' etal ri taqanem we utz.
legal.speechProtected: Ch'owen Chajinïk: Utz yach'o chi rij ri gobierno, ri polisiya, xuquje' ri taq na'oj pa ruwi' e k'o pa jun chik tinimit. Ri ch'owen pa ruwi' ruk'ayewal polisiya nuk'ül ri jikïl qajinïk.
legal.speechSignsSymbols: Taq Etal xuquje' Taq Etal Ruk'u' Nik'aj: Utz yak'waj taq etal, yak'waj taq k'o'ol rik'in retamab'al, xuquje' yak'üt taq etal ruk'u' nik'aj. Ri taq kiq'alajisaxik ri retamab'al pa ruwi' ri nïm na'oj, man utz ta ruma ri k'ulb'äl taqanem.

legal.civilDisobedienceDisclaimer: Re ruchi' re' nuya' nojib'äl pa ruwi' ri taqanem chi rij ri awach'ojlem pa ri k'ulb'äl taqanem pa kib'anik ri taq ch'olanem sipan. Man aj tob'äl pa tzijob'äl ta xuquje' man ruk'utuxik ta richin yatikisaj ri taqanem. Ri ch'olanem sipan ruma rub'anikil nub'ij chi nuk'ül ri taq tzolin richin taqanem ruma ri rub'anik. Junelïk tab'ana' k'utunïk chi re jun aj tob'äl chuwäch, pa, xuquje' chi rij xab'achike k'ulwachinem pa ruwi' ri taqanem.
legal.cdRightToAssemble: Uch'ojlem richin Yemolotäj: Ri Nab'e Enmienda nuchajij ri uch'ojlem ri winaqil richin yemolotäj pa utzil. Re re' nuq'alajisaj ri taq b'inïk, ri taq tzyaqïk, ri taq chakusaxik k'ak', ri taq molnem, xuquje' jun chik kib'anik richin ch'owen pa moloj pa ri taq k'ayij richin konojel.
legal.cdRightToPetition: Uch'ojlem richin Tab'ana' K'utunïk: K'o awach'ojlem pa ri k'ulb'äl taqanem richin tab'ana' k'utunïk chi re ri gobierno richin ninq'ej ri taq itz'eteb'al. Re re' nuq'alajisaj ri ch'olanem, ri k'utuxik, xuquje' ri taq samaj e molom richin ch'olanem ri man itzel ta kib'anik.
legal.cdFreedomOfSpeech: Utzil ruch'owen: Ri ch'olanem pa utzil jun ruwäch ri ch'owen chajinïk. Ri taq etal, ri taq b'ixnik, ri taq wuj, xuquje' ri ch'owen ruk'u' nik'aj (achi'el taq q'ab'aj o taq chakusaxik k'ak' majun ch'owen) ronojel e samaj e chajim ruma ri k'ulb'äl taqanem.
legal.landmarkCourtCases: Taq Tzij Pa Molb'äl Nïm Kiq'ij
legal.caseNaacp: NAACP v. Claiborne Hardware (1982): Ri Nim Molb'äl xuq'alajisaj chi ri taq ruchi' ri ch'olanem ri man itzel ta kib'anik (taq man keloq'öx taj, taq b'inïk, taq ch'owen) e chajim ruma ri k'ulb'äl taqanem tob' we jujun ik'owanela' yekib'än sachoj. Ri aj ch'olanem pa utzil man yetikir ta yeq'alajisaxik pa ruwi' ri kib'anik ri e k'o chik.
legal.caseEdwards: Edwards v. South Carolina (1963): Ri Molb'äl xuq'elebesaj ri kiq'atanem 187 tijoxela' ri e Q'eqchi' e achapom ruma yech'olanik chirij ri jujunanik pa ri nimaläj ja richin ri tinimit. Ri ch'olanem pa utzil pa taq k'ayij richin konojel chajinïk ruma ri 1 xuquje' 14 enmienda.
legal.caseTinker: Tinker v. Des Moines (1969): Ri Molb'äl xuq'alajisaj chi ri yak'amaxik q'eqaq taq q'ab'aj richin ch'olanem chirij ri Ch'öj Vietnam jun ch'owen ruk'u' nik'aj chajinïk. "Ri tijoxela' man nikiq'alajisaj ta ri kich'ojlem pa ri k'ulb'äl taqanem pa ri rochoch chi tijonïk."
legal.caseCox: Cox v. Louisiana (1965): Ri Molb'äl xuq'alajisaj chi ri k'utuxik pa utzil xuquje' ri b'inïk pa ri k'ayij e ruwäch ri ch'owen chajinïk. Po ri gobierno tikirel nuk'ül taq kiq'alajirisaxik pa ruwi' ri q'ijomaj, ri k'ayij, xuquje' ri rub'eyal.
legal.cdGenerallyProtected: Pa Ruk'u' Ri Taqanem Chajinïk: B'inïk pa taq b'e ub'aq ja xuquje' taq k'ayij richin konojel, yak'aman taq etal, b'ixik, yab'än taq wuj, taq chakusaxik k'ak' majun ch'owen, taq man keloq'öx taj, taq ch'uch' ruk'u' winaqil pa taq k'ayij richin konojel, ch'owen ruk'u' nik'aj (taq q'ab'aj, taq b'anojib'äl).
legal.cdMayCrossLines: Rik'in Jub'a' Nuk'ül Pa Rij Ri Taqanem: Q'atanem pa taq b'e o taq okib'äl, yak'aman ri ulew man chwe ta, man ketel taj chi rij jun taqanem pa ruk'u' ri taqanem, yach'in ruk'u' ri taq samaj ri gobierno. Re taq rub'anik re' rik'in jub'a' nub'än chi ye'achäp — tawetamaj ri taq tzolin chuwäch yatok.
legal.movementCivilRights: Rusilanem Taq Ach'ojlem Sipan (1950s-60s): Ri taq tzyaqïk pa kajtz'aqat loq'oj wa, ri Taq B'inïk richin Utzilal, ri Man Keloq'öx Taj richin Montgomery, xuquje' ri B'inïk pa Washington xkikojo' ri ch'olanem sipan ri man itzel ta kib'anik richin yech'olanik chirij ri jujunanik xuquje' yeq'ulu' ri Taqanem richin Taq Ach'ojlem Sipan rech 1964 xuquje' ri Taqanem richin Taq Ach'ojlem richin Chi'öx rech 1965.
legal.movementSuffrage: Ch'öj richin Taq Ixoqib' richin Tob'äl (1848-1920): Ri aj k'amöy b'ey richin taq ixoqib' yekimolotäj taq b'inïk, taq nimaq'ij pa ri Nimaläj Ja Säq, xuquje' taq ch'ijonïk ruma wa'. E k'ïy xeachäp xuquje' xek'ulinik chuwäch ri 19 enmienda xjuxikin.
legal.movementLabor: Rusilanem Samaj (1880s-1940s): Taq ch'öj, taq tzyaqïk, xuquje' taq nimaq'ij xkib'än ch'öj richin ri 8 q'ijomaj richin samaj pa jun q'ij, ri jikelal pa ri samaj, xuquje' ri uch'ojlem richin yekimolotäj. Re taq rub'anik re' xkik'am ri Taqanem richin Taq Ch'akul Samaj Nacionäl xuquje' ri Taqanem richin Taq Nim Ruk'ayewal Samaj.
legal.movementSanctuary: Rusilanem K'astejibal (1980s-pa re q'ij re'): Ri taq ja richin k'ulb'äl xuquje' ri taq tinamit xkiya' k'astejibal chi ke ri e animaeb' ri eleq'om xuquje' ri e k'o pa jun chik tinimit ri majun taq wuj, pa ruwi' ri taq na'oj pa ruk'u' ri k'ulb'äl xuquje' ri uxlab'il richin yekiya' k'astejibal chi ke ri e k'o pa sachoj.

legal.arrestRightToSilence: Uch'ojlem richin Man Yach'o Ta: Tab'ij rajawaxik: "Tajin ninsamajij ri nuch'ojlem richin man ninch'o ta." Man k'atzinel ta yak'ül xab'achike k'utunïk. Xab'achike nab'ij tikirel xuquje' nikokisäx pa awij. Ri man kich'owen ta man tikirel ta nokisäx achi'el etal chi itzel.
legal.arrestRightToAttorney: Uch'ojlem richin K'o Jun Aj Tob'äl: Tab'ij rajawaxik: "Ninwajo ninch'o rik'in jun aj tob'äl." Toq natz'aqatisaj re ach'ojlem re', ri polisiya k'atzinel nikiq'at ri k'utunïk chawe. We man k'o ta awik'in richin natok jun aj tob'äl, jun tikirel niya'ox. Man tak'ül ta k'utunïk k'a ri k'o ri aj tob'äl awik'in.
legal.arrestRightToKnowCharges: Uch'ojlem richin Nawetamaj Ri Taq Kiq'atoj: K'o awach'ojlem richin yab'ij chawe achike tajin yeq'alajisaj pa awij. Tab'ana' k'utunïk: "¿Achike tajin yeq'alajisaj pa nuwi'?" K'o awach'ojlem richin jun aninäq uk'utuxik pa molb'äl (pa ruk'u' ri taqanem 48-72 q'ijomaj).
legal.bookingProcess: Ri Rub'eyal: Ye'ab'än ri wachib'al ruwi' ri aq'ab', ye'ab'än wachib'äl, xuquje' ye'atz'ib'äx ri taq awachanik. Pa ruk'u' ri taqanem k'o awach'ojlem richin nab'än xa ta jun b'ixanem pa teléfono. Rik'in jub'a' ye'ayaka' k'a ri xatz'aqatisaj pa molb'äl o k'a ri xtojïx ri tojoj richin releq'axik.
legal.bookingBail: Tojoj richin Releq'axik: Jun molonela' nujach ri tojoj richin releq'axik pa ruwi' ri taq kiq'atoj, ri ruk'ayewal chi natel el, xuquje' ri ruk'ayewal pa ri tinamit. Taq chanim: Tojoj ruk'u' pwaq (natok ronojel, nutzu' chi rij toq xk'is ri tzij), ruk'u' jun aj tojom (natok 10% chi re jun molonela' tojoj, man nutzu' ta chi rij, man nuya' ta chik), o Releq'axik OR (ye'atel el majun tojoj k'atzinel — pa ruk'u' ri taqanem richin taq kiq'atoj man nïm ta kiq'ij e k'o pa ch'olanem).
legal.doNotExplain: Man tab'ij ta achike xab'än: Man tato' ta richin nab'ij achike xab'än, natz'aqatisaj ri atzij, o "naq'alajisaj" chi ke ri polisiya. Taya' ri atzij chi re ri aj tob'äl.
legal.doNotConsentSearches: Man taya' ta rub'i' richin kanoxïk: Tab'ij: "Man ninwäch ta chi nikanöx." Rik'in jub'a' nikikanöx toq xatchap, po ri ach'owen chi man naya' rub'i' nuchajij ri awach'ojlem richin ri molb'äl.
legal.doNotResist: Man tach'olanik ta ruk'u' ri aq'a': Tob' we nacha'o chi ri chapanïk man utz ta pa ruwi' ri taqanem, man tach'olanik ta ruk'u' ri aq'a'. Ri ch'olanem tikirel nuk'ül ch'aqa' chik kiq'atoj. Taq'ul pa utzil, tab'än achike nikik'utuj, po tatz'aqatisaj ri awach'ojlem ruk'u' ri ach'owen.
legal.doNotSign: Man tajuxuj ta xab'achike we majun ri aj tob'äl awik'in. Man tak'ül ta xab'achike taq ch'akul, taq nukuj kiq'atoj, o taq ch'owen we majun ri aj tob'äl awik'in.

legal.chargeTrespassing: Ok Pa Ri Man Chwe Ta: Ok o yak'aman awi' pa jun k'ayij we majun ya'omaq'ij. Pa ruk'u' ri taqanem pa taq tzyaqïk o pa taq k'ixik ri ja. Pa ruk'u' ri taqanem jun sachoj man nïm ta ruq'ij. Taq multa jalajöj ruma tinimit po ri mas e k'o e $100-$1,000 xuquje' k'a 30 q'ij pa cheeb'. Chajinem: yatikir nab'ij chi ri k'ayij eqel richin konojel o chi tajin nasamajij ri awach'ojlem pa Nab'e Enmienda pa k'ayij richin konojel.
legal.chargeDisorderlyConduct: Samaj Man Utz Ta: Jun q'atanem k'ïy ruwäch ri mas e k'o nokisäx pa taq ch'olanem. Pa ruk'u' ri taqanem nuq'alajisaj "rujuchaxik ri utzilal," "eqal ri xub'an man rajawaxik ta," o "samaj k'o sib'alaj sachoj." Re re' ri mas k'ïy ruk'ayewal k'atanem pa ch'olanem. Pa ruk'u' ri taqanem jun sachoj man nïm ta ruq'ij rik'in taq multa xuquje' rik'in jub'a' jun jub'iq q'ij pa cheeb'. Re taq k'atanem re' ri mas e k'o nikiq'alajisäx chi xqojïx o nikiq'alajisäx chi majun sachoj.
legal.chargeUnlawfulAssembly: Molnem Man Utz Ta: Toq ri taq aj taqanem nikiq'alajisaj jun moloj achi'el "man utz ta" — pa ruk'u' ri taqanem toq nikiq'i' chi k'o "jun etal rajawaxik xuquje' k'o aninäq" richin sachoj o rujuchaxik taq k'ayij. Jun taqanem rajawaxik richin kesanïk k'atzinel niya'ox chuwäch re k'atanem re' nub'än samaj. K'atzinel niya'ox jun q'ijomaj utz chawe richin yatel.
legal.chargeFailureToDisperse: Man Xtel Ta Chi Rij Taqanem richin Kesanïk: Yak'aman awi' chi rij toq xya'ox jun taqanem richin kesanïk pa ruk'u' ri taqanem. Ri taqanem k'atzinel niq'ax xuquje' rajawaxik. K'atzinel niya'ox jun q'ijomaj utz chawe richin yatel. We ri taq b'e richin eleq'axik q'atan ruma ri polisiya, re' tikirel jun chajinem. Tab'ana' etal toq ri taqanem xya'ox xuquje' we k'o jun b'e rajawaxik chawe richin yatel.
legal.chargeObstruction: Q'atanem / Ch'olanem chirij Chapanem: Yach'in ruk'u' ri aq'a' ruk'u' jun aj chajib'äl o yach'olanik chirij jun chapanem pa ruk'u' ri taqanem. Xa ta yok awi' (ch'olanem majun q'eleb'äl) rik'in jub'a' o rik'in jub'a' man nub'ij ta ch'olanem ruma ri taqanem pa ri tinimit. Ri taq ch'olanem ruk'u' ri ch'owen chi ke ri polisiya pa ruk'u' ri taqanem e chajim. Ri ch'olanem ruk'u' ri aq'a' junelïk nuk'ül ch'aqa' chik kiq'atoj — taq'ul pa utzil xuquje' tab'än achike nikik'utuj ruk'u' ri aq'a' toq yatz'aqatisaj ri awach'ojlem ruk'u' ri ach'owen.
legal.chargeFederalVsState: Taq Kiq'atoj Federal Chirij Taq Kiq'atoj ri Tinimit: Ri mas e k'ïy taq chapanem pa ch'olanem e k'atoj ruma ri tinimit o ri k'ayij. Po, taq k'atoj federal yetikir nokisäx pa taq k'ayij federal (taq molb'äl, taq ja federal, taq pa ri ruch'akul juyub' rech nación), toq yekik'waj ri taq ruchi' ri tinimit richin yesik'ij jun ch'öj (Taqanem Chirij Ch'öj), o toq ri ch'olanem nuq'alajisaj taq samaj federal. Ri taq k'atoj federal k'o mas kiq'ij xuquje' yeq'alajisäx pa molb'äl federal.
legal.safetyBuddySystem: Ruk'ayewal Achib'il: Majub'ey tab'e awi' xa rat. Tak'asaj awi' rik'in jun nab'eyik. Tab'ana' jun ch'akul pa achike k'ayij yexmol wi we yejach'. Tab'ij ri anaqoj chi re jun man tajin ta neb' pa ri ch'olanem.
legal.safetyLegalSupport: Ok'öy richin Tob'äl pa Tzijob'äl: Tatz'ib'aj ri rajilab'al ub'i'aj teléfono jun aj tob'äl pa ri aq'ab' ruk'u' tz'ib'anem man nuyuju' ta (ri taq teléfono yetikir yeq'alajisäx). Ri rajilab'al richin b'ixanem National Lawyers Guild: (212) 679-5100. Taya' samaj chi re jun winaq "tob'äl pa cheeb'" ri tikirel nutoj ri tojoj richin eleq'axik xuquje' nuto'on rik'in ri aj tob'äl.
legal.safetyWhatToBring: Achike K'o Rajawaxik Nak'waj: Retamab'al juxon ruma ri gobierno, xab'achike kuna ri k'atzinel (pa ri ruxe'el kajtz'aq), ja', wa', pwaq richin tojoj o richin b'e, jun teléfono k'o chik uchuq'a' rik'in taq rajilab'al richin k'ayewal.
legal.safetyWhatNotToBring: Achike Man Rajawaxik Ta Nak'waj: Xab'achike ruwäch ch'ich'oj, taq kuna o lik'or, taq k'ayij kiq'ij o taq pwaqal, taq samajib'äl ruk'u' kore'al man e rajawaxik ta, xab'achike man nawajo' ta chi yeq'alajisaxik chike, taq lem ri yetz'et pa wachib'äl (taq sik' q'oxom — tak'waj taq lem k'a te rilik).
legal.safetyKnowLocalLaws: Tawetamaj Ri Taq Taqanem Pa Ri Ak'ayij: Takanöx pa ruwi' ri taq rajawaxik richin ya'omaq'ij, ri taq taqanem richin q'ijomaj richin xewarik, xuquje' xab'achike taq taqanem kunoj. Tawetamaj achike taq k'ayij e richin konojel chirij man e richin konojel ta. Tab'etamaj ri taq taqanem kunoj pa ri atinamit pa ruwi' ri molnem man utz ta xuquje' ri man ketel ta chi rij taqanem richin kesanïk.
legal.safetyDeescalation: Nukuj Rutzil: Taq'ul pa utzil xuquje' man taya' ta sachoj. Tayaka' ri aq'ab' eqel richin yetzijtäj. Tach'o pa jun ch'owen utz, man nik'exen ta. Man tab'än ta taq k'exoj man k'o ta pa ret. Tab'än achike nikik'utuj pa ruwi' ri taqanem toq yatz'aqatisaj ri awach'ojlem ruk'u' ri ach'owen.
legal.safetyDocumentEverything: Tab'ana' Etal Ronojel: Tak'uta' pa wachib'äl toq jikïl. Tatz'ib'aj rajilab'al ri taq rajlab'al, ri kib'i' ri taq tob'äl, ri rajilab'al ri taq karro, xuquje' ri q'ijomaj. We natz'ët jun itzel rub'anik, tak'ulu' retamab'al ri e k'o chik xkitz'ët.
legal.safetyMedicalAwareness: Retamaxik Pa Ruwi' Kunab'äl: Tawetamaj pa e k'o wi ri aj kunanel pa ri taq b'e (takanoj taq etal ruk'u' nik'aj ruch'akul krus k'ayew). We nak'ül kuna rajawaxik, tak'waj awik'in. We yeqasaj sik' q'oxom: tab'e pa ri ruk'iyalil ruk'u' ri kyaq, man tachupij ta ri awachib'äl, tab'ana' ch'ajan ruk'u' ja' o ja' richin wachib'äl.
legal.safetyDocumentWhileFresh: Tab'ana' Etal Toq K'a K'ak'a': Tatz'ib'aj ronojel ri nataj nanatäx ri k'a aninäq xk'is: jachin e k'o, achike xk'ulwachitäj, toq xuquje' pa achike k'ayij xk'ulwachitäj, rajilab'al ri taq rajlab'al, kib'i' ri taq etanel, xuquje' xab'achike rub'anik ri chuq'a'. Ri retamab'al aninäq nuyuju'.
legal.safetyFindingLegalSupport: Niqa' Tob'äl pa Tzijob'äl: Tab'ana' ok'öy rik'in ri National Lawyers Guild (NLG) pa (212) 679-5100 richin taq chanim. Ri taq moloj richin tob'äl pa ri tinamit ri mas e k'o k'o kiwäch taq tob'äl kunoj richin ch'olanem. We xatchap, k'o awach'ojlem richin jun chajinel konojel we man k'o ta awik'in richin natok jun aj tob'äl.
legal.safetyFilingComplaints: Yetz'ib'äx Taq Ch'olanem: We xak'ulwachij itzel rub'anik ruma polisiya, tatz'ib'aj jun ch'olanem rik'in ri ruk'ayewal taq samaj pa ri ruchi', ri molb'äl richin ch'olanem pa ri tinamit, xuquje' ri ACLU. Tawachib'alij xab'achike taq k'ax. Tayaka' taq wachib'al ronojel ri taq etal.

legal.mlkQuote: "Jun k'o ruk'ayewal pa uxlab'il richin man nub'än ta ri taq taqanem man utz ta."
legal.mlkAttribution: — Martin Luther King Jr., Wuj Chi Rij Birmingham Cheeb' (1963)
legal.philosophyStoicDuty: Samaj Estoico Richin Tinamit: Ri Estoicos xkik'utuj chi oj aj winaqil richin ri ruwach'ulew nab'ey, xuquje' chi ri utzilal nuk'utuj samaj — man xa ta tz'etoj. Marcus Aurelius xutz'ib'aj: "Ri man utz ta richin ri moloj rech ajkenäl, man tikirel ta nub'än utzil richin ri ajkenäl." Epictetus xuk'utuj chi ri taq chuq'a' richin yekimolotäj ronojel e k'o pa ruwi' xab'achike winaq. Toq ri taq taqanem nikiya' k'ax chi ke ri tinamit, ri na'oj Estoico nuk'utuj chi ri nuchomam xuquje' ri samaj chi ke ri e k'o chik rik'in jub'a' nikik'utuj samaj ruk'u' uxlab'il.
legal.philosophyThoreau: Henry David Thoreau — "Ch'olanem Sipan" (1849): Thoreau xuk'utuj chi ri winaqil k'o kiwäch jun samaj richin yekib'än ri nukutu ri nuchomam pa ruwi' ri taq taqanem man utz ta. Xeq'et pa cheeb' chuwäch nuto' jun toj ruma yok pa samaj ri ch'akoxik xuquje' ri Ch'öj Mexicano-Norteamericano. Ri ruwuj xok jun nimaläj wuj pa ruwi' ch'olanem sipan ri man itzel ta kib'anik, rajawaxik xuto'on chi re Gandhi xuquje' King.
legal.philosophyKing: Martin Luther King Jr. — Wuj Chi Rij Birmingham Cheeb' (1963): King xujach' chi kiwäch ri taq taqanem utz xuquje' ri taq taqanem man utz ta: "Jun taqanem utz jun ruch'akul ruma winaq ri nik'aj rik'in ri taqanem pa uxlab'il. Jun taqanem man utz ta jun ruch'akul ri man nik'aj ta rik'in ri taqanem pa uxlab'il." Xub'ij chi ri samaj rajawaxik ri man itzel ta kib'anik nub'än ri sib'alaj k'ayewal rajawaxik richin k'exoj, xuquje' chi ri e kib'anöy ri nikiq'eleb'ej ri taq taqanem man utz ta k'atzinel nikib'än "pa eqel, ruk'u' loq'oj, xuquje' ruk'u' ri rayinik richin yekikul ri multa."
legal.philosophyGandhi: Mahatma Gandhi — Satyagraha: Ri runa'oj Gandhi pa ruwi' "chuq'a' ruma qas tzij" o "chuq'a' ruma ri animaj" xuk'utuj chi ri ch'olanem sipan ri man itzel ta kib'anik ri mas nïm ruchuq'a' chirij ri man utz ta. Ri runa'oj: majub'ey taya' k'ax chi re ri xawaj chuwäch, tak'ül ri k'axoj majun tzolin, junelïk tab'än qas, xuquje' taq'i' chi ri xawaj chuwäch jun winaq. Ri B'inïk richin Atz'am rech 1930 xuk'ut achike rub'eyal ri sib'alaj ch'olanem sipan tikirel nuk'ex ri nuchomaxik ri winaqil.
legal.philosophyCommonThread: Ri Ch'utin Junam: Chi ke ri Estoicos k'a pa Thoreau k'a pa King k'a pa Gandhi, ri na'oj pa ruwi' ri ch'olanem sipan k'o ruk'aslem pa jun nuchomaxik junam: chi ri winaqil k'o kiwäch jun samaj pa uxlab'il richin yekib'än samaj toq ri taq taqanem o taq ruch'akul nikiya' k'ax chi ke ri e k'o chik, xuquje' chi ri samaj ri man itzel ta kib'anik — nub'än pa eqel xuquje' ruk'u' ri uk'uluxik ri taq tzolin — ri mas nïm ruchuq'a' richin utzilal.

scenarioData.familyKitStep1Explanation: Ri winaq ri' are echakun awi' we k'o jun problema. K'o chi karetamaj wakami, man qas ta k'a we xkik'uluj.
scenarioData.familyKitStep2Script: Chaya' poder chi jun winaq pa kuqub'a awi' chawe echapow le pwaq, ri ak'wal, xuquje' ri apiwersa'.
scenarioData.familyKitStep2Explanation: Jun Power of Attorney (POA) are kub'an che jun winaq chi rech echajow awi' pa le ley. We man b'anom ta, ri tribunal ekijel taq ri decision — xuquje' niqaj q'ij.
scenarioData.familyKitStep3Action: KETAMAJ JAWEJE' K'O WI RI AWUJ
scenarioData.familyKitStep3Script: Kemol taq ri: keb' wuj kuma le gobierno, wuj pa k'atan wi, wuj pa migración, wuj pa salud, wuj pa seguro. Keyaka' ri kopi pa kik'a' ri winaq pa kuqub'a awi'.
scenarioData.familyKitStep3Explanation: We xatb'anik, ri atinimit ekaj ri wuj ri'. Keyaka' ri original pa jun k'ayib'al xuquje' ri kopi pa kik'a' ri aj kuqub'a awi'.
scenarioData.familyKitStep4Action: TAB'ANA' JUN RETAMAB'AL PA LE TIJONEM
scenarioData.familyKitStep4Script: Chacha' keb' o más winaq chi ke echapow taq ri ak'wal pa le tijonem. Chatzijon chi rij pa le oficina pa wuj.
scenarioData.familyKitStep4Explanation: We man k'o ta awik'in, ri tijonem ekaj chi jun autorización pa wuj chawe ekiya' ri ak'wal pa kik'a' jujun.
scenarioData.familyKitStep5Script: Tachapij: jun cargador pa le teléfono, pwaq, taq patán, kopi kech taq ri wuj, wuj le ab'onel, xa jun chik atzak.
scenarioData.familyKitStep5Explanation: We xatb'anik, ri k'o pa le bolsa are kolowin awik'in. Tachapij pa jun k'ayib'al pa k'o wi ri aj kuqub'a awi'.
scenarioData.familyKitStep6Action: TATIJOJ TIQ PA ANIK'AJOL RI RAJ
scenarioData.familyKitStep6Script: Tatijoj: ri raj le ab'onel, jun rajil atinimit, ri Línea Nacional pa Detención (1-833-560-0927).
scenarioData.familyKitStep6Explanation: We man k'o ta awik'in ri teléfono, ri tatijob'an echajow awe pa kab'ij we k'o detención.
scenarioData.familyKitStep7Script: Chatz'onon maltyox chi ri atinimit. Kak'utunik: "We man nintzolij, chatzijon chi ri [b'i'aj le aj kuqub'a awi']."
scenarioData.familyKitStep7Explanation: Ri ak'wal xuquje' ri atinimit ekaj retamaj ri k'o chi b'anik man ruk'in ta xiw. Kak'utuna' ri plan chawe konojel k'o chi kaqakoj.
scenarioData.familyKitOverview: Ri nïm wachinaq are ri chajil awib'. Qas k'ï winaq kech ri xb'anik kechi'aj: "Xnajb'ej we nintzijon chi ri nutinimit." Re moloj re' are kolowin chawe ri atinimit ketamajon, ri wuj k'o wi, xuquje' ri aj kuqub'a awi' keretamajon ri kechak.
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint1: ✓ Chacha' 1-3 winaq pa kuqub'a awi' (ab'onel, tinimit, ajchak)
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint2: ✓ Tab'ana' jun Power of Attorney pa pwaq xuquje' ak'wal
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint3: ✓ Kemol xuquje' kab'ana' kopi kech konojel ri wuj
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint4: ✓ Keyaka' autorización pa wuj pa le tijonem
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint5: ✓ Tachajij jun bolsa rik'in ri nïm taq jastaq
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint6: ✓ Tatijoj ri rajil le ab'onel xuquje' ri línea pa detención
scenarioData.familyKitKeyPoint7: ✓ Chatz'onon maltyox chi ri atinimit — kak'utuna' ri plan
scenarioData.familyKitWarrantJudicialDesc: Taq wuj, keta'mexik, retamab'al pa tijonem, bolsa, taq raj tijob'an, tz'onob'al rik'in tinimit.
scenarioData.familyKitWarrantAdminDesc: Majun plan pa ak'wal, taq wuj qas sakon, majun ab'onel chapon, tinimit man ketaman ta.
scenarioData.doorDesc: Retamab'al kech taq ch'ab'al chawe katz'onon pa le uchieb'al man ruk'in ta kejiqib'a'.
scenarioData.doorStep1Explanation: Mani' tab'ana' kejiqib'a' le uchieb'al. Chatz'onon pa le uchieb'al.
scenarioData.doorStep2Script: Tab'ana' utz, kaxik pa le uchieb'al le akib'i'aj o chak'oja' pa le ventana.
scenarioData.doorStep2Explanation: K'o ri aq'ij pa ketamaj jachin are.
scenarioData.doorStep3Action: TATZ'ONAJ WE K'O JUN ORDEN KUMA JUN JUEZ
scenarioData.doorStep3Script: ¿K'o jun orden tzib'an kuma jun juez? Tab'ana' utz, kaxik pa le uchieb'al.
scenarioData.doorStep3Explanation: ICE ekaj jun orden judicial (tzib'an kuma jun juez) pa keok pa le awachoch. Jun orden administrativa MAN USI' TA.
scenarioData.doorStep4Script: Man kinb'ij taj chi k'o iwi' pa keok pa le nuwachoch. Kinb'anik ri nuq'ij chi man kintz'onon ta xuquje' ninwajo' kintz'onon rik'in jun ab'onel.
scenarioData.doorStep4Explanation: Ri 5º Enmienda are kolik'oj ri aq'ij chi man katz'onon ta.
scenarioData.doorStep5Script: Tachapa' kab'ij o kavideo pa le ventana we ütz.
scenarioData.doorStep5Explanation: K'o ri aq'ij pa katzijon chi rij ri ejilan kuma le ley pa le awuchieb'al.
scenarioData.doorOverview: ICE man k'o ta kiwi' pa keok pa le awachoch we majun orden judicial tzib'an kuma jun juez. K'o ri aq'ij pa le Constitución ri ekelik'oj awe.
scenarioData.doorKeyPoint2: ✓ Tatz'onaj chi rij le orden pa le uchieb'al o ventana
scenarioData.doorKeyPoint3: ✓ Tak'utunik we ri orden tzib'an kuma jun juez (judicial) o jun ajchak ICE (administrativa)
scenarioData.doorKeyPoint4: ✓ Taq orden administrativa MAN ekiya' ta permiso pa ICE pa keok pa awachoch
scenarioData.doorKeyPoint5: ✓ K'o ri aq'ij chi man katz'onon ta
scenarioData.doorKeyPoint6: ✓ K'o ri aq'ij chi man kaya' ta k'uxaj pa taq k'utunïk
scenarioData.doorWarrantJudicialDesc: Ekiya' permiso pa ICE chi keok pa awachoch
scenarioData.doorWarrantAdminDesc: MAN ekiya' ta permiso chi keok pa awachoch
scenarioData.streetDesc: ¿K'o ri awi' pa kinb'e? Achike rub'anik ri aq'ij chi man katz'onon ta pa le tinamital.
scenarioData.streetStep1Action: TATZ'ONAJ WE K'O RI AWI' PA KINB'E
scenarioData.streetStep1Explanation: Re k'utunïk re' are ri nïm. We kechi'aj chi ja', maltyox tab'e.
scenarioData.streetStep2Action: MAN TAYA' TAQ K'UXAJ PA TAQ K'UTUNÏK
scenarioData.streetStep2Script: Kinb'anik ri nuq'ij chi man kintz'onon ta. Man kinwajo' ta kinb'ij k'uxaj.
scenarioData.streetStep2Explanation: K'o ri aq'ij pa le 5ª Enmienda chi man katz'onon ta.
scenarioData.streetStep3Action: MAN TAYA' PERMISO PA TAQ KANIK'OXIK
scenarioData.streetStep3Script: Man ninb'ij taj chi k'o iwi' pa kanik'oxik.
scenarioData.streetStep3Explanation: Ri 4ª Enmienda are kolik'oj chi rij taq kanik'oxik man ruk'in ta ütz.
scenarioData.streetStep4Explanation: K'o ri aq'ij chi k'o jun ab'onel awik'in.
scenarioData.streetStep5Explanation: Ri chajinem are nimalaj chawe ri ajilnem.
scenarioData.streetStep5Script: Kechapa' ri aq'ab'aj pa k'o wi keya'tajik. Man tatanimaj ta. Kattzoq k'u'x xuquje' kaya' qas rutzil.
scenarioData.streetOverview: Pa taq k'ayib'al pa tinamital, ICE k'o chi ketz'eto' chawij. K'o ri aq'ij chi man katz'onon ta xuquje' chi katz'onaj we k'o ri awi' pa kinb'e. Man tatanimaj ta, man tab'ana' taq rakib'al, xuquje' man tak'utuj taq wuj man qas ta pa awichin.
scenarioData.streetKeyPoint1: ✓ Jutaqal tatz'onaj "¿K'o ri nuwi' chi kinb'e?"
scenarioData.streetKeyPoint2: ✓ K'o ri aq'ij chi man katz'onon ta
scenarioData.streetKeyPoint3: ✓ Man k'o ta chi kaya' k'uxaj chi rij ri awetamab'al pa migración
scenarioData.streetKeyPoint4: ✓ Man tatanimaj ta o man tab'ana' ta chikojinem
scenarioData.streetKeyPoint5: ✓ Man tab'ana' ta taq rakib'al o man tak'utuj ta taq wuj man qas ta
scenarioData.streetKeyPoint6: ✓ Kattzoq k'u'x xuquje' kechapa' ri aq'ab'aj pa k'o wi keya'tajik
scenarioData.streetWarrantJudicialDesc: Tatz'onaj we k'o ri awi' pa kinb'e. Kab'ana' ri aq'ij chi man katz'onon ta. Tatz'onaj jun ab'onel.
scenarioData.streetWarrantAdminTitle: Ri Man K'o Ta Chi B'anik
scenarioData.streetWarrantAdminDesc: Man tatanimaj ta. Man tab'ana' taq rakib'al. Man tak'utuj ta taq wuj man qas ta. Man tab'ana' ta chikojinem rik'in ri aq'ab'aj.
scenarioData.vehicleDesc: Taq q'ij pa k'utunïk we xatch'ayik kuma ICE pa karro. Orden xuquje' permiso.
scenarioData.vehicleStep1Script: Kechapa' ri aq'ab'aj pa le timón. Tab'ana' ketz'ilik ri luces we k'ekum.
scenarioData.vehicleStep1Explanation: Kattzoq k'u'x xuquje' k'o chi katz'ijtajik. Man tab'ana' taq animanem man tz'aqat ta.
scenarioData.vehicleStep2Explanation: K'o ri aq'ij chi ketamaj ruma achike xch'ayik.
scenarioData.vehicleStep3Script: Wate' k'o wi le nulicencia xuquje' registro.
scenarioData.vehicleStep3Explanation: K'o chi kaya' re taq wuj re' we kajiqib'a' karro. Chajalajij chi ri ajchak b'aq'a chawech koch'apo.
scenarioData.vehicleStep4Script: Kinb'anik ri nuq'ij chi man kintz'onon ta. Man ninb'ij taj chi k'o iwi' pa kanik'oxik. Ninwajo' kintz'onon rik'in jun ab'onel.
scenarioData.vehicleStep4Explanation: Man k'o ta chi kaya' k'uxaj pa taq k'utunïk man xa ta pa kaya' licencia xuquje' registro.
scenarioData.vehicleStep5Script: Tatz'apij ri akarro xuquje' man taya' ta permiso pa kanik'oxik. K'o chi katzijon video pa le ventana.
scenarioData.vehicleStep5Explanation: We ketz'ononik pa kelesaj, k'o chi kab'an, pero k'o chi man kaya' ta permiso pa kanik'oxik.
scenarioData.vehicleOverview: Pa jun ch'ayinem pa karro, k'o chi kaya' ri alicencia xuquje' registro. Man xa ta ri', k'o ri aq'ij chi man katz'onon ta. Man k'o ta chi kaya' permiso pa kanik'oxik ri akarro.

scenarioData.vehicleKeyPoint2: ✓ Taya' licencia xuquje' registro we ketz'ononik
scenarioData.vehicleKeyPoint3: ✓ Chajalajij chi ri ajchak b'aq'a chawech koch'apo ri wuj
scenarioData.vehicleKeyPoint4: ✓ K'o chi man katz'onon ta man xa ta pa kaya' etamab'al
scenarioData.vehicleKeyPoint5: ✓ K'o chi man kaya' ta permiso pa kanik'oxik ri akarro
scenarioData.vehicleKeyPoint6: ✓ Ri winaq k'o pa karro k'o chi ketz'onaj we k'o kiwi' pa keb'e
scenarioData.vehicleWarrantJudicialDesc: ICE ekaj jun orden pa kanik'oxik ri akarro we man kaya' ta permiso.
scenarioData.vehicleWarrantAdminDesc: Chajalajij chi qas: "Man ninb'ij taj chi k'o iwi' pa kanik'oxik."
scenarioData.borderDesc: Taq q'ij pa taq k'ayib'al pa frontera xuquje' taq checkpoint pa naj.
scenarioData.borderStep1Script: Puerto de Entrada xuquje' Checkpoint Pa Naj — jalajoj taq regla.
scenarioData.borderStep1Explanation: Pa ri frontera qitzij, jub'a' taq q'ij. Pa taq checkpoint pa naj (rik'in 100 millas), k'ï chik taq chajinem.
scenarioData.borderStep2Script: Taya' k'uxaj chi rij ri alugar pa k'atanwi. K'o chi kanik'oxik chawij.
scenarioData.borderStep2Explanation: Pa le frontera qitzij, CBP k'o k'ïy kiwi'.
scenarioData.borderStep3Script: Man k'o ta chi kaya' k'uxaj man xa ta chi rij ri alugar pa k'atanwi. K'o chi man katz'onon ta.
scenarioData.borderStep3Explanation: Taq checkpoint pa naj (rik'in US) k'o jalajoj taq regla.
scenarioData.borderStep4Script: ¿Kinb'an detención o k'o ri nuwi' chi kinb'e? Kinb'anik ri nuq'ij chi man kintz'onon ta.
scenarioData.borderStep4Explanation: Pa taq checkpoint pa naj, k'o chi kajalajij ri aq'ij pa le 5ª Enmienda.
scenarioData.borderStep5Action: MAN TAYA' TA PERMISO PA TAQ KANIK'OXIK
scenarioData.borderStep5Script: Man ninb'ij taj chi k'o iwi' pa kanik'oxik le nuwakarro.
scenarioData.borderStep5Explanation: Asta pa taq checkpoint, k'o chi man kaya' ta permiso pa kanik'oxik.
scenarioData.borderOverview: K'o keb' ruwach k'ulinem pa frontera: Puerto de Entrada qitzij (ri frontera qitzij) xuquje' taq checkpoint pa naj (rik'in 100 millas kech le frontera). Ri aq'ij jalajoj pa jujun k'ayib'al.
scenarioData.borderKeyPoint1: ✓ Pa Puerto de Entrada: Jub'a' taq q'ij, k'o chi kaya' k'uxaj chi rij lugarpa k'atanwi
scenarioData.borderKeyPoint2: ✓ Pa taq checkpoint pa naj: K'ï chik taq q'ij, k'o chi man katz'onon ta man xa ta chi rij lugarpa k'atanwi
scenarioData.borderKeyPoint3: ✓ Man tab'ana' ta taq rakib'al chi rij ri alugar pa k'atanwi
scenarioData.borderKeyPoint4: ✓ K'o chi man tak'utuj ta taq wuj man xa ta ri licencia we kajiqib'a' karro
scenarioData.borderKeyPoint5: ✓ K'o chi man kaya' ta permiso pa kanik'oxik ri akarro
scenarioData.borderKeyPoint6: ✓ Tab'ij ri k'o chi b'anik we ütz
scenarioData.borderWarrantJudicialDesc: Jub'a' taq q'ij. CBP k'o nïm kiwi' pa kanik'oxik. Taya' k'uxaj pa taq k'utunïk.
scenarioData.borderWarrantAdminDesc: K'ï chik taq q'ij. K'o chi man katz'onon ta. K'o chi man kaya' ta permiso pa kanik'oxik we majun orden.
scenarioData.workplaceDesc: ICE pa taq k'ayib'al pa chak. Man tatanimaj ta, man katz'onon ta.
scenarioData.workplaceStep1Script: Ri animik k'o chi kab'anik chi awij. Tatkojo' pa k'o wi at wila'.
scenarioData.workplaceStep1Explanation: Ri animik k'o chi kab'anik achi' etzaqatisan. Kattzoq k'u'x.
scenarioData.workplaceStep2Script: Kinb'anik ri nuq'ij chi man kintz'onon ta. Ninwajo' kintz'onon rik'in jun ab'onel.
scenarioData.workplaceStep2Explanation: K'o ri aq'ij chi man katz'onon ta pa chak.
scenarioData.workplaceStep3Script: Man ninb'ij taj chi k'o nuwi' chi keqak'utuj taq wuj we majun ab'onel.
scenarioData.workplaceStep3Explanation: Man k'o ta chi kak'utuj taq wuj pa autorización pa chak chi ICE.
scenarioData.workplaceStep4Action: TATZ'ONAJ WE K'O RI AWI' PA KINB'E
scenarioData.workplaceStep4Explanation: We k'o, k'o chi katanimaj we man xab'anik ta detención.
scenarioData.workplaceStep5Script: ICE ekaj jun orden judicial pa keok pa taq k'ayib'al man tinamital ta pa chak.
scenarioData.workplaceStep5Explanation: Taq k'ayib'al man tinamital ta pa chak k'o ri kixik taq chajinem achi' jun wachoch.
scenarioData.workplaceOverview: ICE k'o chi ketz'eto' pa taq k'ayib'al pa chak. Pa taq k'ayib'al tinamital, k'o k'ï kiwi'. Pa taq k'ayib'al man tinamital ta, ekaj jun orden judicial. K'o ri aq'ij chi man katz'onon ta xuquje' chi katz'onaj jun ab'onel.
scenarioData.workplaceKeyPoint2: ✓ Kab'ana' ri aq'ij chi man katz'onon ta
scenarioData.workplaceKeyPoint3: ✓ Man tak'utuj ta taq wuj we majun ab'onel
scenarioData.workplaceKeyPoint4: ✓ Tatz'onaj we k'o ri awi' pa kinb'e
scenarioData.workplaceKeyPoint5: ✓ ICE ekaj jun orden judicial pa taq k'ayib'al man tinamital ta pa chak
scenarioData.workplaceKeyPoint6: ✓ K'o chi man kaya' ta k'uxaj pa taq k'utunïk
scenarioData.workplaceWarrantJudicialDesc: ICE ekaj jun orden judicial pa keok pa taq k'ayib'al man tinamital ta pa chak (k'ayib'al pa uxlanem, oficinas).
scenarioData.workplaceWarrantAdminDesc: ICE k'o chi keok pa taq k'ayib'al tinamital (lobby, k'ayib'al pa taq kich'akela') we majun orden.
scenarioData.protestTitle: Taq Q'ij Pa B'anob'al Chi Rij
scenarioData.protestDesc: Ütz taq b'anik xuquje' taq k'atbal pa le ley pa taq b'anob'al maltyox.
scenarioData.protestStep1Script: Kinb'anik maltyox ri nuq'ij pa le 1ª Enmienda chi kemoltajik.
scenarioData.protestStep1Explanation: Ri 1ª Enmienda are kolik'oj ri q'ij chi kemoltajik maltyox pa taq k'ayib'al tinamital.
scenarioData.protestStep2Script: Tatkojo' pa taq acera, parques, xuquje' taq plaza tinamital. Man tach'oj ta taq uchieb'al o taq b'e.
scenarioData.protestStep2Explanation: Taq k'ayib'al tinamital k'o chajinem. Taq propiedad privada ekajik permiso.
scenarioData.protestStep3Script: Kinb'anik ri nuq'ij pa le Constitución chi kemoltajik maltyox. ¿Kinb'an detención o k'o ri nuwi' chi kinb'e?
scenarioData.protestStep3Explanation: Maltyox chajalajij ri aq'ij. Tatz'onaj we xab'an detención.
scenarioData.protestStep4Script: Tab'ij ri q'ij, ri ruma, xuquje' kab'an. Tab'ij ronojel.
scenarioData.protestStep4Explanation: We man kab'an ta pa jalawinem, k'o chi kab'anik jun detención.
scenarioData.protestStep5Script: Kinb'anik ri nuq'ij chi man kintz'onon ta. Ninwajo' jun ab'onel.
scenarioData.protestStep5Explanation: Man tab'ana' ta chikojinem. Tab'e' malajuj we k'o chi. Chajalajij ri aq'ij pa ch'ab'al.
scenarioData.protestOverview: Ri 1ª Enmienda are kolik'oj ri aq'ij chi kemoltajik maltyox xuquje' kab'anik protestas. Re k'o wi marchas, taq mitines, xuquje' taq demostración pa taq k'ayib'al tinamital. Man xa ta ri', k'o taq k'atbal pa le ley k'o chi karetamaj.
scenarioData.protestKeyPoint1: ✓ K'o chi kab'an protesta pa taq acera xuquje' parques tinamital
scenarioData.protestKeyPoint2: ✓ K'o chi katzijon taq foto xuquje' video pa taq protesta
scenarioData.protestKeyPoint3: ✓ Ri polisiya man k'o ta kiwi' chi man kekiya' ta chi kab'an protesta ruma ri kech'ab'al
scenarioData.protestKeyPoint4: ✓ K'o chi permisos pa nïm taq moloj o pa kech'oj taq b'e
scenarioData.protestKeyPoint5: ✓ Ri winaq chi kech'oj chi rij k'o ri kixik taq q'ij achi' ri'at
scenarioData.protestKeyPoint6: ✓ K'o chi kab'anik detención we kech'oj taq b'e o keok pa propiedad privada
scenarioData.protestWarrantJudicialDesc: Kemoltajinem maltyox, kek'amon taq señal, kech'ab'anen, kemiminen pa taq acera, kab'anik video.
scenarioData.protestWarrantAdminDesc: Koyob'al, kesachik propiedad, kech'ojinik taq b'e pa taq ambulancia, keokik pa propiedad privada.
scenarioData.recordingDesc: Jampa xuquje' achike rub'anik k'o chi katzijon chi rij ri chak kuma ICE.
scenarioData.recordingStep1Script: Kinb'anik ri nuq'ij pa le 1ª Enmienda chi kinb'an video pa jun k'ayib'al tinamital.
scenarioData.recordingStep1Explanation: Kab'anik video pa polisiya xuquje' ICE pa taq k'ayib'al tinamital k'o chajinem pa le Constitución.
scenarioData.recordingStep2Script: Tatkojo' k'a 10 pies o más naj. Man tach'oj ta ri kichak.
scenarioData.recordingStep2Explanation: K'o chi katzijon video pero man k'o ta chi kach'oj ri kichak ri ejilan kuma le ley.
scenarioData.recordingStep3Script: Man ninch'oj taj. Kinb'anik video ik'in jun k'ayib'al tinamital xuquje' are ri nuq'ij pa le Constitución.
scenarioData.recordingStep3Explanation: Maltyox chajalajij ri aq'ij. Man tach'ab'ana' ta o man tab'ana' ta k'ax.
scenarioData.recordingStep4Script: Kekojo' taq aplicación ri kekiya' pa cloud automáticamente. Man tayuja' ta ri video we ketz'ononik.
scenarioData.recordingStep4Explanation: Ri ajilan kuma le ley man k'o ta kiwi' chi kekiq'atonik chi kab'an yujb'al pa taq video o chi kech'apo ri atelefono we majun orden.
scenarioData.recordingStep5Script: Tab'ij: q'ij, k'ayib'al, taq rab'aj taq placa, agencia, rub'i' taq karro, xuquje' achike xb'an.
scenarioData.recordingStep5Explanation: Re etamab'al re' are kolowin chi rech kechajow winaq pa le tinamit xuquje' kekik'amon taq cuenta ri agencias.
scenarioData.recordingOverview: Ri 1ª Enmienda are kolik'oj ri aq'ij chi katzijon video pa polisiya xuquje' ajilan kuma ICE pa taq k'ayib'al tinamital. Re k'o wi taq acera, parques, xuquje' jujun chik taq k'ayib'al tinamital. Man k'o ta chi kab'anik detención xa ruma kab'anik video, pero man k'o ta chi kach'oj ri kichak.
scenarioData.recordingKeyPoint1: ✓ K'O CHI katzijon video pa ejilan kuma le ley pa taq k'ayib'al tinamital
scenarioData.recordingKeyPoint2: ✓ Tatkojo' naj ütz (10+ pies chi ruwach)
scenarioData.recordingKeyPoint3: ✓ Man tab'ana' ta ch'ojinem rik'in ri aq'ab'aj pa ri kichak
scenarioData.recordingKeyPoint4: ✓ Ri ajilan man k'o ta kiwi' chi keyuja' ri avideo
scenarioData.recordingKeyPoint5: ✓ Ri ajilan ekaj jun orden chi kech'apo ri atelefono
scenarioData.recordingKeyPoint6: ✓ Tab'ij ri video pa cloud asta b'aq'a
scenarioData.recordingWarrantJudicialDesc: Kab'anik video malaj pa tinamital. Chajalajij ri aq'ij pa le 1ª Enmienda. Tab'ij ri video pa cloud.
scenarioData.recordingWarrantAdminDesc: Man tab'ana' ta ch'ojinem. Man tatok ta pa propiedad privada. Man tach'oj ta ri kichak.

postEncounterData.detainedReleasedDesc: Xab'anik detención kuma ICE/DHS xuquje' xayakatajik. Ri nab'e 24-72 horas are nïm taq — ri prueba eresaj, taq fecha pa le ley kechap, xuquje' we majun chajinem ri winaq kech'omow pa taq fecha pa tribunal o ekesach ri kik'esal.
postEncounterData.familyTakenDesc: Jun awinaq pa atinimit xb'an detención kuma ICE. Ri nïm chawech are chi keqaril jaweje' k'o wi, keqaya' tob'anem pa le ley, xuquje' keqab'ana' ri plan pa ri atinimit.
postEncounterData.agentsLeftTitle: Taq Ajilan Xeb'e We Majun Okib'al
postEncounterData.agentsLeftDesc: ICE/DHS xekitz'eto' pa le awuchieb'al pero xeb'e we majun okib'al. Xab'ana' ri aq'ij — wakami tab'ij achike xk'ulun xuquje' tachajij awib' chawe k'o chi ketzolij.
postEncounterData.documentNowDrContent: Ri natab'al eresaj asta' b'aq'a we xk'ulun jun mal. Chatzib'aj ronojel ri kanataj wakami — b'i'aj, taq rab'aj taq placa, achike xk'ulun, achike xb'an. Re' ekok jun prueba nïm pa le ab'onel xuquje' we k'o jun reclamo chik apan.
postEncounterData.documentNowDrCheck1: Chatzib'aj taq b'i'aj xuquje' taq rab'aj taq placa kech konojel ri ajilan xawil
postEncounterData.documentNowDrCheck2: Chatzib'aj ri q'ij, ri ramaj, xuquje' ri k'ayib'al pa xb'an ri detención
postEncounterData.documentNowDrCheck3: Chajalajij achike xkitz'onon chi awe ri ajilan xuquje' achike xab'ij chi ke
postEncounterData.documentNowDrCheck4: Chatzijon taq foto pa taq k'ax, golpes, o taq jal pa le apropiedad
postEncounterData.documentNowDrCheck5: Chatzib'aj taq b'i'aj xuquje' achike rub'anik keta'mexik rik'in jujun chik winaq ri xkil
postEncounterData.documentNowDrCheck6: Keyaka' konojel ri wuj xkiya' chi awe (NTA, taq wuj pa bond, recibos)
postEncounterData.documentNowDrCheck7: Chatzib'aj pa jawi' xatkojow xuquje' jampa
postEncounterData.documentNowDrCheck8: Tab'ij ri k'aslemal pa detención (wa, ya', taq tob'al, temperatura)
postEncounterData.documentNowDrCheck9: Tab'ij we man xkiya' ta chi awe jun ab'onel o jun tz'onb'al pa teléfono
postEncounterData.legalHelpDrContent: K'o wi xak'ulu' jun Notice to Appear (NTA) rik'in jun fecha pa tribunal. We majun ab'onel, ri taq porcentaje pa deportación qas e k'ï. Ri tribunal pa migración man kekiya' ta taq ab'onel sipan — k'o chi katzukun ri awib'. Tachap asta' b'aq'a.
postEncounterData.legalHelpDrCheck1: Chatz'eton rik'in jun ab'onel pa migración asta' b'aq'a
postEncounterData.legalHelpDrCheck2: Chatz'onon pa Línea Nacional pa Detención: 1-833-560-0927
postEncounterData.legalHelpDrCheck3: Chatz'eton rik'in ri aorganización pa tob'anem legal pa le ak'ayib'al
postEncounterData.legalHelpDrCheck4: Tatz'onaj jun lista kech taq ab'onel pro bono ik'in ri tribunal pa migración
postEncounterData.legalHelpDrCheck5: Kemol konojel ri wuj pa migración pa le ab'onel
postEncounterData.legalHelpDrCheck6: Chatz'onon chi ri ab'onel chi rij taq opción pa jun molob'al pa reducción pa bond
postEncounterData.legalHelpDrCheck7: We man k'o ta apwaq pa jun ab'onel, chatz'eton rik'in NILC o taq organización kech taq q'ij pa taq aj inmigrante
postEncounterData.bondCourtDrTitle: KETAMAJ RI ABOND XUQUJE' TAQ FECHA PA TRIBUNAL
postEncounterData.bondCourtDrContent: We man katok ta pa jun fecha pa tribunal, asta' b'aq'a ekab'an jun orden pa deportación. Ri wuj NTA k'o ri afecha pa tribunal xuquje' ri k'ayib'al. Ri retamaxik ri sistema k'o chi kolowin chi katkojo' o chi katesajik.
postEncounterData.bondCourtDrCheck1: Chatzukuj ri aNTA xuquje' chatzib'aj ri afecha pa tribunal, ramaj, xuquje' k'ayib'al
postEncounterData.bondCourtDrCheck2: Chawil jachin ri tribunal pa migración k'o jurisdicción pa le ak'esal
postEncounterData.bondCourtDrCheck3: Ketamaj ri kik'uluj ri bond xuquje' we k'o taq requisitos pa reportar
postEncounterData.bondCourtDrCheck4: Tab'ana' k'ï taq alarmas pa le afecha pa tribunal — tatok b'aq'a
postEncounterData.bondCourtDrCheck5: Tachajij konojel ri wuj ri ekaj le ab'onel b'aq'a chawech ri molob'al
postEncounterData.bondCourtDrCheck6: Ketamaj chi k'o chi katz'onaj jun continuación we ekaj k'ï chik q'ij pa jun ab'onel
postEncounterData.bondCourtDrCheck7: Ketamaj chi ri tribunal pa migración are civil, man criminal ta — pero ri consecuencias qas e nïm achi' kiwa'
postEncounterData.preserveEvidenceDrContent: Taq kab'ij, taq foto, xuquje' taq wuj kekesach ri kiwach pa le ley we kejal o man qas ütz ta kab'an. Ri cadena de custodia nïm pa tribunal. Tab'ij ronojel wakami xuquje' man tajal ta ri original.
postEncounterData.preserveEvidenceDrCheck1: Tab'ij konojel ri kab'ij pa jun k'ayib'al ütz (Google Drive, correo chi ri ab'onel)
postEncounterData.preserveEvidenceDrCheck2: MAN TAB'ANA' TA edición, recorte, o jaloj pa taq video o taq audio
postEncounterData.preserveEvidenceDrCheck3: Tab'ij taq screenshot xuquje' konojel ri metadata (timestamps, coordenadas GPS)
postEncounterData.preserveEvidenceDrCheck4: Tataqa' pa correo konojel ri prueba chi ri ab'onel asta' b'aq'a
postEncounterData.preserveEvidenceDrCheck5: Chatzib'aj ri cadena de custodia pa jujun prueba (jachin xuk'ulu', jampa)
postEncounterData.preserveEvidenceDrCheck6: We xab'an SafeNeighbor pa kab'ij, chakomonik ri backup rik'in ri ab'onel
postEncounterData.preserveEvidenceDrCheck7: Keyaka' taq mensaje, taq tz'onb'al, xuquje' jujun chik tz'onob'al rik'in ri ajilan
postEncounterData.fileComplaintDrContent: We ri ajilan xkisach ri aq'ij — xeok we majun orden judicial, xkib'an nïm koyob'al, xkich'ojow pa jun ab'onel, o xkib'an taq amenaza — k'o chi katzijon jun reclamo federal. K'ï winaq man ketaman ta chi k'o re taq k'ayib'al re'.
postEncounterData.fileComplaintDrCheck1: Tab'ana' jun reclamo pa DHS Office of Inspector General (OIG)
postEncounterData.fileComplaintDrCheck2: Tab'ana' jun reclamo pa DHS CRCL (Office for Civil Rights and Civil Liberties)
postEncounterData.fileComplaintDrCheck3: Chatz'eton rik'in ri oficina le Procurador General pa le awEstado
postEncounterData.fileComplaintDrCheck5: Tab'ij ri fecha pa reclamo xuquje' ri numero pa k'esal pa le awuj
postEncounterData.fileComplaintDrCheck6: Chatz'onon chi ri ab'onel chi rij taq reclamo pa taq q'ij civiles (Section 1983)
postEncounterData.findThemFtContent: ICE k'o chi keresaj taq aj detención chuwach taq k'ayib'al we man keta'mexik ta. Ruma k'a asta' xatzukuj, ruma k'a asta' k'o chi kaya' jun ab'onel xuquje' kechap ri proceso pa bond. Kekojo' ri ICE Online Detainee Locator xuquje' chatz'onon pa línea pa detención.
postEncounterData.findThemFtCheck1: Chatz'onon pa Línea Nacional pa Detención: 1-833-560-0927
postEncounterData.findThemFtCheck2: Kekojo' ri ICE Online Detainee Locator pa locator.ice.gov
postEncounterData.findThemFtCheck3: Chatz'onon pa oficina ICE ERO (Enforcement and Removal Operations) pa le ak'ayib'al
postEncounterData.findThemFtCheck4: Tawil we xkich'apo chi jun k'ayib'al jalajoj
postEncounterData.findThemFtCheck5: Chatzib'aj ri b'i'aj le k'ayib'al, dirección, teléfono, xuquje' taq ramaj pa tz'etoj
postEncounterData.findThemFtCheck6: Chatz'onaj chi rij ri rab'aj registro kech achi' aj extranjero (A-number) we man k'o ta awik'in
postEncounterData.findThemFtCheck7: Chawil we xkilow kuma jun juez chik
postEncounterData.legalHelpFtContent: Ri winaq k'o pa detención k'o ri kiq'ij chi k'o jun ab'onel, pero ri gobierno MAN ekiya' ta. K'o chi katzukun xuquje' kaqalokeb' jun pa kib'i'. Ri q'ij nïm — ri taq decisión pa elegibilidad pa bond asta' b'aq'a keb'an.
postEncounterData.legalHelpFtCheck1: Chatz'eton rik'in jun ab'onel pa migración pa ri kib'i'
postEncounterData.legalHelpFtCheck2: Chatz'onon pa taq organización pa tob'anem legal pa referencia
postEncounterData.legalHelpFtCheck3: Chatz'eton rik'in NILC o taq organización kech taq q'ij pa taq aj inmigrante
postEncounterData.legalHelpFtCheck4: Kemol ri kiwuj pa migración pa le ab'onel
postEncounterData.legalHelpFtCheck5: Chatz'onon chi ri ab'onel chi rij elegibilidad pa bond xuquje' jampa ekab'an ri molob'al
postEncounterData.legalHelpFtCheck6: Chawil we k'o kiq'ij pa jun molob'al pa bond o we k'o chi kakoyo'
postEncounterData.legalHelpFtCheck7: We man k'o ta kiq'waq pa jun ab'onel, chatz'onon chi rij representación pro bono
postEncounterData.poaActivationFtTitle: TAB'ANA' ACTIVACIÓN PA POWER OF ATTORNEY
postEncounterData.poaActivationFtContent: We xachajij jun Power of Attorney pa ri Moloj Chajil Pa Tinimit, wakami are ekab'an activación. Re' are kekiya' poder legal chi awe pa kajilan taq pwaq, ak'wal, autorización pa tijonem, xuquje' jujun chik taq b'anik nïm pa kib'i'.
postEncounterData.poaActivationFtCheck1: Chatzukuj ri wuj pa Power of Attorney
postEncounterData.poaActivationFtCheck2: Chata'mexaj taq banco xuquje' taq institución financiera rik'in jun kopi pa POA
postEncounterData.poaActivationFtCheck3: Chatz'eton rik'in ri tijonem kech ri ak'wal rik'in autorización pa custodia/recoger
postEncounterData.poaActivationFtCheck4: Tachajij chajinem pa ak'wal achi' ri plan pa emergencia pa tinimit
postEncounterData.poaActivationFtCheck5: Tab'ij taq cuenta financiera komon achi' k'o autorización
postEncounterData.poaActivationFtCheck6: Chata'mexaj pa le apatron we ekaj (FMLA, permiso pa ausencia)
postEncounterData.poaActivationFtCheck7: We majun POA k'o, chatz'onon rik'in jun ab'onel chi rij tutoría pa emergencia
postEncounterData.notifyNetworkFtContent: Tab'ana' activación pa ri keta'mexik pa kuqub'a awi', taq organización pa tinamit, xuquje' taq comunidad kech ri k'ulb'al. Man k'o ta chi katb'an ri' xa awib'. Ri amoloj pa tob'anem k'o chi kolowin rik'in chajinem pa ak'wal, coordinación pa taq pwaq legal, xuquje' tob'anem pa k'u'x.
postEncounterData.notifyNetworkFtCheck1: Chata'mexaj konojel ri keta'mexik pa kuqub'a awi' ik'in ri plan pa emergencia
postEncounterData.notifyNetworkFtCheck2: Chata'mexaj taq organización pa tinamit (taq grupo pa tob'anem, taq grupo kech taq q'ij pa taq aj inmigrante)
postEncounterData.notifyNetworkFtCheck3: Chatz'eton rik'in taq ajaw pa taq komunidad religiosas o pa k'ulb'al pa tob'anem
postEncounterData.notifyNetworkFtCheck4: Tab'ana' jun cadena pa tz'onob'al pa taq actualización chi rij ri k'esal
postEncounterData.notifyNetworkFtCheck5: Tak'ajlaj jun GoFundMe o jun moloj pa tinamit pa taq pwaq legal
postEncounterData.notifyNetworkFtCheck6: Chatz'onaj tob'anem rik'in taq chak jujun q'ij (ak'wal, wa, transporte)
postEncounterData.notifyNetworkFtLinkLabel: Ketz'et Ri Keta'mexik Pa Kuqub'a Awi'
postEncounterData.documentFtContent: Estape' man ri'at ta ri xab'an detención, tab'ij ronojel ri xawil. Ri atetamal xuquje' ri prueba k'o chi kolowin nïm pa ri kichajinem pa le ley xuquje' we k'o taq reclamo chi rij sachoj pa taq q'ij.
postEncounterData.documentFtCheck1: Chatzib'aj ronojel ri xawil — taq ramaj, ajilan, taq b'anik
postEncounterData.documentFtCheck2: Keyaka' we k'o taq kab'ij, taq foto, o taq video pa ri k'ulutajinem
postEncounterData.documentFtCheck3: Chatzib'aj taq b'i'aj xuquje' achike rub'anik keta'mexik rik'in jujun chik winaq ri xkil
postEncounterData.documentFtCheck4: Keyaka' kopi kech konojel ri wuj xkiq'atik ri ajilan
postEncounterData.documentFtCheck5: Tab'ij we k'o taq jal pa le apropiedad o taq jastaq xkich'apo
postEncounterData.documentFtCheck6: Tab'ij we k'o taq ch'ab'al xkib'an ri ajilan chi rij ri ruma pa detención
postEncounterData.documentVisitAlContent: Estape' ri ajilan xeb'e, ri b'anik tab'ij pa ri tz'etoj are kab'an jun registro k'o chi kolowin chik apan — pa le ab'onel, pa retamaxik ri tinamit, xuquje' we ketzolij rik'in jun orden.
postEncounterData.documentVisitAlCheck1: Chatzib'aj ri q'ij qas, ri ramaj, xuquje' jampa xkokotajik ri tz'etoj
postEncounterData.documentVisitAlCheck2: Chatzib'aj janipa ajilan xkokotaj xuquje' achike rub'i' kik'oje'
postEncounterData.documentVisitAlCheck3: Tab'ij achike xkitz'onon xuquje' achike xab'ij chik
postEncounterData.documentVisitAlCheck4: Keyaka' we k'o taq wuj, taq tarjeta, o taq aviso xkiq'atik
postEncounterData.documentVisitAlCheck5: Tawil we k'o taq karro pa vigilancia k'a kech'amo' naj we xeb'e
postEncounterData.documentVisitAlCheck6: Chatzib'aj taq rab'aj taq placa, rub'i' taq karro, o taq número kech taq placa
postEncounterData.documentVisitAlCheck7: Tab'ij ri tz'etoj pa SafeNeighbor Reportes Pa Tinamit
postEncounterData.followupPatternsAlContent: ICE k'o chi ketzolij. Ri retamaxik ri kib'anik kolowin pa achajinem. Ri tzolinem jutaqal keb'an pa ri saqarib'al b'aq'a (5-7 AM) o pa le ak'ab' chuwach. K'o chi ketz'eto' chik pa le achak o pa le ak'ayib'al.
postEncounterData.followupPatternsAlCheck1: Tab'e' awib' chawe ketzolij, qas pa le saqarib'al b'aq'a (5-7 AM) o pa le ak'ab' chuwach
postEncounterData.followupPatternsAlCheck2: Ketamaj chi ICE k'o chi ketz'eto' pa le ak'ayib'al o kekitz'onon pa awichoch chi ri awichakib'al
postEncounterData.followupPatternsAlCheck3: Tab'e' awib' chi k'o chi ketz'eto' chawij pa le achak chik
postEncounterData.followupPatternsAlCheck4: K'o chi ketzolij rik'in jun orden judicial ri jun chik mul — ketamaj ri jalajoj
postEncounterData.followupPatternsAlCheck6: Tak'utunik rik'in taq organización pa tinamit we jujun chik pa le ak'ayib'al xkik'ulu' taq tz'etoj kiwa'
postEncounterData.followupPatternsAlCheck7: Tak'ajlaj jalow ri ajujun q'ij awichak pa jun ramaj
postEncounterData.fortifyPrepAlContent: Re k'ulutajinem re' are jun k'oxom pa anik'ajol. Kekojo' chawe kab'an más chik nïm ri aplan pa tinimit, kak'utuna' ri taq ch'ab'al, xuquje' tab'ana' chi konojel pa le awachoch ketaman achike k'o chi b'anik we ri ajilan ketzolij.
postEncounterData.fortifyPrepAlCheck1: Tak'utunik xuquje' tab'ana' más k'a k'ak' ri Moloj Chajil Pa Tinimit
postEncounterData.fortifyPrepAlCheck2: Tab'ana' chi ri Power of Attorney k'ak' xuquje' notarizado
postEncounterData.fortifyPrepAlCheck3: Tab'ana' más k'a k'ak' ri keta'mexik pa kuqub'a awi' rik'in taq detalle pa ri tz'etoj wakami
postEncounterData.fortifyPrepAlCheck4: Kak'utuna' taq ch'ab'al pa le uchieb'al rik'in konojel ri tinimit chik
postEncounterData.fortifyPrepAlCheck5: Tab'ana' chi konojel pa le awachoch ketaman: MAN TAB'ANA' KEJIQIB'A' LE UCHIEB'AL
postEncounterData.fortifyPrepAlCheck6: Tak'ajlaj kab'an yakoj jun cámara pa le uchieb'al o jun cámara pa seguridad
postEncounterData.fortifyPrepAlCheck7: Tab'e' pa jun taller Ketamaj Ri Aq'ij pa le ak'ayib'al
postEncounterData.consultAttorneyAlContent: Jun tzolinem k'o chi k'ulun rik'in jun orden judicial. Ri tz'onob'al rik'in jun ab'onel pa migración wakami — b'aq'a chawech k'o jun k'ax — k'o chi kolowin chawe ketamaj ri ataq opción xuquje' kachajij ri ak'esal b'aq'a.
postEncounterData.consultAttorneyAlCheck1: Tab'ana' jun cita rik'in jun ab'onel pa migración
postEncounterData.consultAttorneyAlCheck2: Taqeb'ej taq wuj pa ri tz'etoj (ri atzib'axik, we k'o taq wuj xkiq'atik)
postEncounterData.consultAttorneyAlCheck3: Chatz'onon chi rij ri awetamab'al pa migración xuquje' taq debilidad
postEncounterData.consultAttorneyAlCheck4: Ketamaj achike nub'ij jun orden judicial xuquje' jun orden administrativa chawech
postEncounterData.consultAttorneyAlCheck5: Chatz'onon chi rij salida voluntaria xuquje' taq proceso pa deportación
postEncounterData.consultAttorneyAlCheck6: Chak'ulu' ri rab'aj teléfono pa emergencia le ab'onel pa taq k'ulutajinem chik apan
postEncounterData.courtRightsContent: Ri tribunal pa migración are civil, man criminal ta — pero ri consecuencias qas e nïm achi' kik'aslemal. Ri retamaxik ri sistema are kekiya' jun ütz opción chi awe xuquje' chi ri ab'onel. Re are ri fundamentos k'o chi konojel ketaman.
postEncounterData.courtRightsInfo1: Ri tribunal pa migración are civil, man criminal ta — pero k'o chi katb'an detención pa ronojel ri proceso
postEncounterData.courtRightsInfo2: K'o ri aq'ij chi k'o jun ab'onel, pero ri gobierno MAN ekiya' ta jun sipan
postEncounterData.courtRightsInfo3: K'o chi katz'onaj jun continuación (delay) pa atzukuxik jun ab'onel
postEncounterData.courtRightsInfo4: Taq molob'al pa bond kekijel we k'o chi kayakatajik pa ruk'a' ri ak'esal are kab'an
postEncounterData.courtRightsInfo5: K'o chi katzijon apelación pa taq decisión pa Board of Immigration Appeals (BIA)
postEncounterData.courtRightsInfo6: MANI' kech'omow jun fecha pa tribunal — are kab'an jun orden automática pa deportación
postEncounterData.courtRightsInfo7: K'o ri aq'ij chi ketak'utuj konojel ri prueba ri gobierno k'o chi awij
postEncounterData.courtRightsInfo8: K'o chi katz'onaj alivio pa deportación (asilo, cancelación pa deportación, etc.)
postEncounterData.resourcesContent: Re taq organización re' kekiya' tob'anem legal, taq servicio pa katzukuxik aj detención, retamab'al chi rij taq q'ij, xuquje' kab'anik taq reclamo. Keyaka' re taq rab'aj re' wakami.

rightsCard.title: K'oxomil Tawetamaj Ri Taq Awech'akul
rightsCard.subtitle: Jun k'oxomil richin morral rik'in ri taq awech'akul ajowäx. Tak'ama' jun ruwachib'äl rutz'uyul, tawujb'ej, o takomonij. Nisamäx tz'aqät majun okem pa ri ach'ab'äl.
rightsCard.right1: MAN TAJÄQ TA RI WÄCH we jun ajk'amol b'e pa koq'axel tajin yeruch'oy ri wäch.
rightsCard.right2: MAN TATZAQATISAJ TA TAQ K'UTUNÏK chi re jun ajk'amol b'e pa koq'axel we tajin yech'owen chawik'in. K'o ri awech'akul richin yak'amöy ch'owen.
rightsCard.right3: MAN TATZ'IB'AJ TA XABACHIKE WUJ we man xach'owen ta nab'e rik'in jun aj k'atb'al tzij. K'o ri awech'akul richin yach'owen rik'in jun aj k'atb'al tzij.
rightsCard.right4: We yat pa ruchi' ri awäch, tak'utuj chi re ri ajk'amol b'e we ütz chi yab'e' xuquje' we yerub'ij chi ja', tab'e' pa uxlanïk.
rightsCard.right5: TAK'ÜT RE K'OXOMIL RE' CHI RE RI AJK'AMOL B'E. We yat pa ri awäch, tak'üt ri k'oxomil pa ri ruwi'il wäch o tak'ök'ej pa ruxe' ri wäch.
rightsCard.agentHeader: TAYA' RE CHI RE RI AJK'AMOL B'E
rightsCard.assertion1: Man ninwajo' ta yinch'owen awik'in, nintzaqatisaj ri taq ak'utunïk, o nintz'ib'aj o ninya' chawe xab'achike wuj ruma ri nuwech'akul pa ri Rukaj 5 Ch'owen pa ri Rutzijol Cholb'al re Estados Unidos.
rightsCard.assertion2: Man ninya' ta q'ij chawe richin yatok pa ri nuwäch ruma ri nuwech'akul pa ri Rukaj 4 Ch'owen pa ri Rutzijol Cholb'al re Estados Unidos, xa xe we k'o jun rutzijol richin yatok, tz'ib'an ruma jun q'atöy tzij o jun ruxe'el q'atöy tzij rik'in ri nub'i' pa ruwi', ri yak'ök'ej pa ruxe' ri wäch.
rightsCard.assertion3: Man ninya' ta q'ij chawe richin yanik'oj xab'achike chi re ri nuwachinäq ruma ri nuwech'akul pa ri Rukaj 4 Ch'owen.
rightsCard.assertion4: Nincha'o yinwokisaj ri nuwech'akul pa ri Rutzijol Cholb'al.
rightsCard.agentFooter: Re taq k'oxomil re' eyakon chi kiwäch ri aj tinamït xuquje' ri man aj tinamït ta.
rightsCard.hotlineLabel: Rajilab'al K'ayb'alil Pa Koq'axel Pa Ronojel Ri Tinamït
rightsCard.disclaimer: Man taqanem ta richin. Tach'owen rik'in jun aj k'atb'al tzij k'o ruya'oj q'ij.
rightsCard.shareDescription: Tayak o takomonij re k'oxomil re' richin junelïk k'o chawik'in.
